_comment: Page refresh registry for the VR.org maintenance audit. Each page lists its file path, refresh cadence in days, and a one-line refresh checklist. Run `npm run audit:pages` to see what is overdue.
policy: Best-of and pillar pages drive the majority of vr.org traffic. They must be refreshed on the cadence below. Real content edits required, not just dateModified bumps (Google's freshness signals discount unchanged content).

checklist: Verify each headset's price and availability in deals.json
Update 'What's Coming in 2026' section with confirmed launches
Refresh FAQ if a major release shifts the buyer recommendation
Top 10 all-time list rarely changes; review for new instant classics
Refresh Honorable Mentions with the year's standout titles
Update FAQ if a new game enters the must-play conversation
Move shipped games from 'anticipated' to 'released so far' with launch dates
Add internal links to VR.org launch articles for each
Refresh FAQ to reflect the released-not-anticipated lineup
Tighten the 'What to watch for' close based on the latest hardware news
Verify each app is still actively maintained (kill anything shuttered)
Refresh the Honorable Mentions section with new apps gaining traction
Update the visionOS / Meta AI / spatial-AI commentary
Verify subscription pricing for each app (Supernatural, FitXR, Les Mills)
Add new fitness titles that have launched since last refresh
Refresh the 'How to get started' tips with the latest accessory recs
Verify the recommended first headset is still the right call
Update 'What to play first' list if a new beginner-perfect title shipped
Keep accessory pricing within ~20% of current retail
AR moves fast. Refresh 'What is coming' with confirmed Android XR / Meta / Apple news
Update Ray-Ban Meta, Rokid, Xreal, Viture pricing and feature notes
Add any new entrant that has captured > 5% of category share
Evergreen explainer; only update when the technology landscape shifts meaningfully
Verify the 'history' and 'future' sections still reflect current state
Update headset pricing references
Hub page; verify card grid links match the live pillar pages
Update card descriptions if a pillar page shifts focus
Source of truth is data/deals.json, not the page
Verify every product is still in stock and price is within ~10% of listed
Add new launches (e.g. Steam Controller after May 4) and remove EOL items
Source of truth is data/events.json
Add upcoming VR / AR conferences and game launches
Mark or remove past events
